---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new peripheral, verification feature, or ASIC flow improvement
title: "[FEAT] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Summary

A concise description of the feature you'd like to see added.

## Motivation

What problem does this solve? Who benefits from it?

## Proposed Design

Describe the high-level design:
- For RTL: what module, what interface (AXI/APB), memory-map address range
- For firmware: what API, what driver functions
- For verification: what sequences, what coverage targets
- For ASIC flow: what script or configuration change

## Alternatives Considered

Have you considered other approaches? Why is this one better?

## Additional Context

Any related issues, references, or prior art (e.g. a peripheral in another open-source SoC).
